decisions.reason: I agree. The replayed metrics drifted away from what was played, so their deltas say nothing about the world, and I judged round 16 by the run as it was played. This belongs to the studio's metrics tooling, not the world, so the world has no change for it. The echo's case did change, from 'North north ...' to 'north north ...'. That is intended: Sprout no longer recapitalises prose, and Zork's echo is lower case (friction 17 and 70 are marked).

The round-16 revision already moved the bar's rule onto the refusals players actually meet in the Cellar, and TOUCHBIT is unchanged. Nothing more to make until round 17 shows whether a player who reads the rule looks for another road home. This is also why the trap door stays one object per side this round (see S1).
Already made in the round-16 revision: the Cellar now says when the trap door above it stands open, in both BRIEF and full descriptions. It stays on the round-17 watch list.
I agree no world change is needed: the shaft and the torch already point at each other. A run aimed at the mine, or one that starts mid-game, is the director's call.
The maze and the coal mine stay as Zork built them; dropping things to mark rooms is the classic answer. Maze no_way lines are a player mapping, not the world failing.
The thief is read as the intent hopes: an unseen someone. Kept as is.
All three phrasings were fixed in the round-16 revision, and mountains.json and the trap-door tests still pass at 2c85fd7. Round 17's metrics, played at this world, should confirm it.
Already fixed in the revision: each item is answered in turn, and take_from_box.json pins it. The inventory nesting it uncovered (friction 18) is now answered by verbatim prose; see S1.

Checked at the pin. 'knock on the boarded door politely' and 'open the window wider' now drop the leftover word and restate the reading in brackets. 'drop everything except X and Y' now works. Friction 94, 120, 132 and 69 are marked answered or changed. Still failing: 'go back' (unknown), 'push open the window' and 'take all but X' (both not_here), and 'empty sack' (unknown). These stay logged.

I agree, and it remains friction 70. A line naming something that is not there never reaches the room, so the room cannot echo it. The new `as actor for any` cannot say which verb it refuses, so it cannot echo 'look look ...' either.
The room text stays Zork's, and the 'changed version' framing is the director's to weigh. No world change.
Everything reached and praised is kept. The list of things still unmet stays on intent's round-17 watch list.
No change of its own. P2 and P3, both already made, are the levers on the goal-seeker's score. The 350 ending still needs a longer cap or a mid-game start, which is the director's call.

This is a refine round at the new pin, with no new scope and Zork I whole. I checked friction.md against every feature in the list, dropped the workarounds where the feature now does the job, and marked 23 entries answered, answered in part, changed or not answered. Several workarounds stay, each for a stated reason: the trap door stays one door per side until round 17 has tested the bar's rule on the Cellar's side; the Loud Room's per-verb echoes stay because the actor wildcard cannot name its verb; `take all` keeps its guess, because sprout#838 does not apply where Portable plays `take`; the rooms' state copies stay, because a describe still cannot read another room's property. Two features had no workaround in this world to drop: drawn exits and NPC acts that fill a value role. The port also uncovered a live bug: the new `empty_handed` engine line had taken over the chimney's passage. It is fixed and logged as friction 141.

changes.what: Fixed 'drop all' with empty hands, which answered with the chimney's line. The new engine line `empty_handed` was being found on the adventurer's existing passage of the same name. The chimney's passage is now `chimney_bare`, and the world writes `empty_handed` as Zork's 'You are empty-handed.' Logged as friction 141.

Zork's stock answers on Thing, and on the kinds that type a verb (Creature, Lockable, Door, Inflatable and the rest), are now `default` plays. 301 `without` lines were removed wherever the same body writes its own play, including Bag's three (friction 29). A `without` that only silences stays. Portable's own plays stay non-default.

GHOSTS-F is now one `as target for any except examine, attack, mung, exorcise, talk, ask, greet` wildcard, replacing about 25 generated without-and-play pairs (friction 124). exorcism.json: 'take spirits' is now a refusal, and kick and greet steps were added.

DEAD-FUNCTION's 'You can't even do that.' is now one `as actor for any except ...` wildcard on the adventurer, replacing 70 per-verb refusals. Verbs with their own dead line, and those the dead may do, are left out of it (friction 125). spirit.json gained 'kick gate' and 'listen' steps.

The kitchen window is one `kitchen_window` standing in both the Kitchen and Behind House. `:window_sync`, its pass rule and both rooms' `:window_open` are gone, and the exits and descriptions read the window itself (friction 16, answered in part). New test window_sides.json, which also pins 'drop all' with empty hands.

UP-CHIMNEY-FUNCTION is now a permit on the adventurer's part of `go`, using `here.is(ChimneyFoot) && way == "up"`. `:at_chimney` is gone, and the trap door's re-barring (TOUCHBIT) now reads `from` on `:moved` (friction 42).

The inventory nests and indents as Zork's PRINT-CONT does: a `held_lines` passage on Box, with indentation written as `{verbatim}` spaces. A box's contents in a room and under LOOK IN are indented two spaces (friction 18). Test lines changed only in leading spaces, except egg.json, where the canary inside the held egg is now listed by name as Zork lists it rather than by its first description.
The move count skips refusals in the deafening Loud Room, as LOUD-ROOM-FCN's own loop does (friction 140). loud_room.json and loud_noise.json are back to their earlier counts.

The grating and the Altar's hole count the skeleton key and the coffin in the actor's hand directly; `:keys` and `:coffins` are gone (friction 58, 72). DIAGNOSE uses `20 * (wounds - 1)` and `score / 70` in place of its ladders of ifs (friction 93).
Version bumped to 0.4.0, because `sprout compat` reports the removed properties and paths break saves of 0.3.0.

Friction updated: 23 entries marked answered, answered in part, changed or not answered by the new features (11, 16, 17, 18, 18 again, 23, 29, 36 again, 42, 58, 69, 70, 72, 89, 93, 94, 120, 124, 125, 132, 135, 139, 140), and new entry 141. Intent gained a section on this revision and two round-17 watch items: the indented inventory and the bracketed restatements.
